findings.evidence: Nothing of the sort exists upstream: grep `Gamma_le_one|one_le_Gamma|Gamma_lt_one` over ./upstream/mathlib and ./upstream/TauCeti yields only `TauCeti.regularizedGamma_le_one` (IncompleteGamma.lean:357); the input lemma is `Real.Gamma_mul_add_mul_le_rpow_Gamma_mul_rpow_Gamma` (Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Gamma/BohrMollerup.lean:58).
findings.fix: Factor it out as a standalone lemma in the `Real` namespace, e.g. `Real.Gamma_le_one (h1 : 1 ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ 2) : Real.Gamma x ≤ 1`, and make `one_lt_integral_exponentiatedRadiator` a two-line consequence.
findings.issue: `hΓle : Real.Gamma (1 + β) ≤ 1` is a general fact about `Real.Gamma` on `[1,2]` (log-convexity between Γ(1)=Γ(2)=1) with no radiator content, inlined as a case split plus a 7-lemma `rwa` massage of Mathlib's Hölder form. It hides a reusable lemma inside a physics theorem.

findings.evidence: Lines 154-157: `apply Complex.ofReal_injective; rw [h, Complex.ofReal_div, ← Complex.Gamma_ofReal]; push_cast; rfl`.
findings.fix: Replace with `norm_cast`, or name the missing cast step explicitly (`Complex.ofReal_div` / `Complex.Gamma_ofReal` in the right direction); if a `rfl` is genuinely required, add a comment saying which coercion it discharges.
findings.issue: `integral_exponentiatedRadiator` ends `push_cast; rfl`: the bare `rfl` closes a coercion goal that `push_cast` did not normalise to syntactic equality (otherwise `rfl` would fail with "no goals"), i.e. the proof rests on undocumented defeq across `Complex.ofReal` wrappers.

findings.evidence: Lines 90-93 give `exponentiatedRadiator_def (β z : ℝ)` pointwise; lines 139-141 re-derive the function-level equation inline inside the `rw`.
findings.fix: State the characterising lemma at function level (`exponentiatedRadiator β = fun z => exp (…) / Γ (1 + β) * betaPDFReal 1 β z := rfl`, or add it alongside the pointwise one) and `rw` with it directly.
findings.issue: `rw [show exponentiatedRadiator β = fun z => ... from funext (exponentiatedRadiator_def β), ...]` is an undocumented `show`/`funext` eta workaround, needed only because `exponentiatedRadiator_def` is stated pointwise while `mellinDis` consumes the function.

findings.evidence: `Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < re s) : Gamma s ≠ 0` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Gamma/Beta.lean:454 — the same PR already uses it at Mellin.lean:450.
findings.fix: `have hΓ : Complex.Gamma (1 + β) ≠ 0 := Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by simp; linarith)`.
findings.issue: `hΓ : Complex.Gamma (1 + β) ≠ 0` is proved by a four-step `ofReal`/`Gamma_ofReal` rewrite chain, which breaks on any cast-lemma rename, although a single Mathlib lemma gives it from `(1 + (β : ℂ)).re = 1 + β > 0`.

findings.fix: `simp [beta_comm, beta_one_right hβ]` (or `simp only [...]` with those two plus `ring_nf`) after the `betaPDFReal` unfold.
findings.issue: `rw [beta_comm, beta_one_right hβ, sub_self, Real.rpow_zero, one_div_one_div, mul_one]`: only the first two rewrites carry content; the remaining four are plain simp lemmas, making the step a rename-fragile chain.

summary: The Mellin/Beta proofs are well factored through the shared private integrand lemma, but the radiator file buries a general reusable Gamma fact inside a physics theorem, closes a cast goal with an undocumented bare `rfl`, and uses a `show ... from funext` eta workaround plus a hand-rolled cast chain where a Mathlib lemma applies.
